notes: Abracon. 2.0 x 1.6 x 1.0 mm molded power inductor, shielded; the package is 0806 in JLCPCB's record (2016 metric), which has no row of std/kicad.toml, so the project maps it to a footprint of its own. Columns: inductance is 3.3 uH at 1 MHz / 1.0 V and the tolerance column of the table prints the code M, which is the standard code for +/- 20%; the datasheet does not print the percentage, so the 20% is the code's and not a printed figure. saturation_current is 2.4 A: the table prints Isat 2.8 A under Typ and 2.4 A under Max, and the Max column is the smaller, so it is the one taken (the current at which the inductance drops 30% from its nominal value; JLCPCB lists 2.4 A). dc_resistance is 0.14 ohm, the table's maximum (typical 115 mohm, which JLCPCB lists). rms_current is 2.1 A, the Max column of Irms (typical 2.3 A): the DC current that causes a temperature rise of approximately 40 C from 25 C ambient. temp_min and temp_max are left empty: the datasheet's -40 C to +125 C operating temperature includes the part's own temperature rise (page 1), so it is not an ambient figure. Land pattern and polarity: Abracon page 4; the datasheet numbers no pads.
